AnalysisStatus.description: Status of the AI analysis. Analysis failed is a status, not a lifecycle state (OD-09).
AnalysisStatus.title: AnalysisStatus

EventRole.description: Why an event belongs to an incident. Context events are never treated as malicious.
EventRole.title: EventRole

IncidentEventLink.description: Link from an incident to one event (FR-08).

link_keys.description: Keys that linked the event. Empty only for the event that started the incident.
link_keys.title: Link Keys

linked_at.description: When the event was linked, UTC.
linked_at.title: Linked At

role.description: flagged, or context: an unflagged or unlabelled event that shares an entity in the window (OD-02). A context event is never treated as malicious.

IncidentEventLink.title: IncidentEventLink

IncidentStatus.description: Lifecycle state (FR-31, TD-11). new replaces the former name Detected.
IncidentStatus.title: IncidentStatus

LinkKey.description: The entity key that linked an event to the incident (NFR-SF-05).
LinkKey.title: LinkKey

RiskAssessment.description: Deterministic risk score computed by C3 code, never by the LLM (OD-04, OD-05, FR-18).

computed_at.description: When the score was computed, UTC.
computed_at.title: Computed At

config_version.description: Version of the weights and thresholds file used.
config_version.title: Config Version

level.description: Level from the configurable thresholds (FR-20); enforced by C3's scoring code, not by this contract.

RiskAssessment.title: RiskAssessment

RiskFactor.description: One factor of the deterministic risk score.

contribution.description: Points this factor adds to the score.
contribution.title: Contribution

name.description: Factor name from the risk configuration.
name.title: Name

weight.description: Weight of the factor in the configuration.
weight.title: Weight

RiskFactor.title: RiskFactor

RiskLevel.description: Risk level derived from the score by C3's configurable thresholds (FR-20).
RiskLevel.title: RiskLevel

description: A group of related events (FR-07, FR-08, FR-11, FR-18 to FR-20, FR-31, FR-42).

confidence.description: Confidence of the latest valid analysis (OD-16); set exactly when analysis succeeded (FR-42).
confidence.title: Confidence

created_at.description: When the incident was created, UTC.
created_at.title: Created At

events.description: Linked events (FR-08); event IDs are unique.
events.title: Events

first_event_at.description: Timestamp of the earliest event, UTC.
first_event_at.title: First Event At

incident_type.description: C3 classification, read by C5's scenario lookup (OD-20); null = not classified yet.
incident_type.title: Incident Type

last_event_at.description: Timestamp of the latest event, UTC; not before first_event_at.
last_event_at.title: Last Event At

latest_report_id.description: ID of the latest valid AnalysisReport; required when analysis succeeded.
latest_report_id.title: Latest Report Id

risk.description: Deterministic risk assessment; null = not scored yet.

updated_at.description: Last change, UTC; not before created_at.
updated_at.title: Updated At

title: Incident
